title: Scalable topological quantum computing based on Sine-Cosine chain models
summary: This work proposes a scalable framework for topological quantum computing using Matryoshka-type Sine-Cosine chains. These chains support high-dimensional qudit encoding within single systems, reducing the physical resource overhead compared to conventional qubit arrays. We describe how these chains can be used in Y-junction braiding protocols for gate operations and in extended memory architectures capable of storing multiple qubits simultaneously.
